  421   def itemActive?(ignoreFainted = false)
  422     return false if fainted? && !ignoreFainted
  423     return false if @effects[PBEffects::Embargo] > 0
  424     return false if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::MagicRoom] > 0
  425     return false if @battle.corrosiveGas[@index % 2][@pokemonIndex]

  430   def hasActiveItem?(check_item, ignore_fainted = false)

  433     return self.item == check_item

  437   # Returns whether the specified item will be unlosable for this Pokémon.
  438   def unlosableItem?(check_item)
  439     return false if !check_item
  440     item_data = GameData::Item.get(check_item)
  441     return true if item_data.is_mail?
  442     return false if @effects[PBEffects::Transform]
  443     # Items that change a Pokémon's form
  444     if mega?   # Check if item was needed for this Mega Evolution
  445       return true if @pokemon.species_data.mega_stone == item_data.id
  446     else   # Check if item could cause a Mega Evolution
  447       GameData::Species.each do |data|
  448         next if data.species != @species || data.unmega_form != @form
  449         return true if data.mega_stone == item_data.id
  450       end
  451     end
  452     # Other unlosable items
  453     return item_data.unlosable?(@species, self.ability)
  454   end

  695   # Returns whether the given position belongs to the opposing Pokémon's side.
  696   def opposes?(i = 0)
  697     i = i.index if i.respond_to?("index")
  698     return (@index & 1) != (i & 1)
  699   end

  762   # Returns the battler that is most directly opposite to self. unfaintedOnly is
  763   # whether it should prefer to return a non-fainted battler.
  764   def pbDirectOpposing(unfaintedOnly = false)
  765     @battle.pbGetOpposingIndicesInOrder(@index).each do |i|
  766       next if !@battle.battlers[i]
  767       break if unfaintedOnly && @battle.battlers[i].fainted?
  768       return @battle.battlers[i]
  769     end
  770     # Wanted an unfainted battler but couldn't find one; make do with a fainted
  771     # battler
  772     @battle.pbGetOpposingIndicesInOrder(@index).each do |i|
  773       return @battle.battlers[i] if @battle.battlers[i]
  774     end
  775     return @battle.battlers[(@index ^ 1)]
  776   end
